criteria: Read timing 100ns and write timing 250ns measured from backend acceptance
Absent write_access_time preserves prior read/write timing
Every accepted request completes once with matching ID
Malformed, negative, or incompatible units rejected clearly
Controller/link overhead separated from backend latency in the oracle
Targeted executable checks and neighboring regression pass
rule: Pass only when all criteria have evidence. Missing runtime validation is blocked, not pass. Evaluate behavior; do not require a particular implementation.
